text:
emma: FYI customer (acme-inc) reporting weird behaviour after monthly refill — UI shows credits back but API returns 429 for ~20m. They included curl repro. Can someone pick this up? ticket#12345

zoe: I'm on it, grabbing the curl + headers now.

emma: curl they ran:
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-DEMO\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"test\"}'
```
Response headers they pasted: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests`
`x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`
`x-cache: HIT from edge-12`

zoe: thanks. @raj any known edge-cache/quotas flakiness around a refill window?

raj: saw a similar flare yesterday. TL;DR: refill job writes balances to origin, but edge quota cache invalidation sometimes lags if invalidation queue backs up. UI refreshes balance from origin so it looked refilled. API traffic hitting edge saw stale quota and got 429.

emma: customer says UI showed +120k tokens at 10:03 but API 429 persisted until ~10:23. They are in CET region.

raj: can you ask them to paste `x-quota-cache` / `x-cache` headers when they hit 429? Also which key type (org/service/project)?

emma: they sent back: `x-cache: HIT`, `x-quota-cache: stale-ttl=240` and they're using a service key tied to org-acme-42.

raj: that matches cache lag. @ops-bot what does job log show for the refill + invalidation timestamps?

ops-bot: monthly-refill job for org-acme-42 ran at 1719009000. Quota-cache invalidation was queued (priority=low) and processed at 1719010100 due to backlog on invalidation-workers. Invalidation backlog peaked at 1800 entries. See run: https://console.redwood/jobs/1719009000

maria: billing confirms the top-up write completed successfully at 1719009000. No payment issues. UI pulls fresh balance and bypasses edge for user sessions which is why it looked refilled immediately.

zoe: proposed immediate mitigation: 1) ask customer to retry after 2-3m (once invalidation processed) or 2) call `/v1/balance?no_cache=true` (we have an endpoint for origin-check) while we clear edge. I'll share a sample: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-DEMO\" -H \"Cache-Control: no-cache\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/balance?no_cache=true
```

raj: longer-term fix: bump invalidation priority for monthly-refill and add backpressure metrics so invalidation-workers scale faster during refill window. I'll open PR to set post-refill TTL to 10s and bump queue priority.

emma: shared workaround with customer; they retried after ~3m and everything worked. Customer happy for now but asked for root cause and ETA for fix.

raj: created INC-2026-042 and will add RCA + timeline. For now, turning invalidation priority to high for monthly-refill (hotfix) — deploying in a few mins.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: refill-invalidation-priority-hotfix v2026.03.17 -> staging -> prod (tracking: #PR-578).

zoe: nice, please ping me when prod deploy finishes and I'll follow up to close the ticket. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll send customer a short note explaining the cache-lag behaviour and that we applied a priority hotfix; include apology and INC link.

emma: great teamwork — closing the support loop once you confirm deploy.

raj: prod deploy completed, invalidation latency back to normal. Marking incident as mitigated.

zoe: confirmed with customer, they got 200s on subsequent calls. closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
